title: add RAG templates, agent tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Added RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to docs and redwood-examples. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: Provide production-ready RAG templates and end-to-end agent/tool-calling quickstarts so developers can get started quickly with retrieval-augmented generation and tool integrations. This PR bundles curated templates, sample prompts, TypeScript + Python examples, and docs site quickstarts that demonstrate tool-calling and sane defaults for batching, caching, and model selection.

What I changed: - docs/site: added /quickstarts/rag and /quickstarts/agents pages with step-by-step guides and code snippets. - redwood-examples/agents: new example apps (ts-agent-tooling, py-rag-demo) showing tool-calling, function schemas, and local RAG indexing using the eval-harness dataset. - templates/rag: three RAG prompt templates (faq, conversational, extractive) plus metadata and recommended eval prompts. - docs: added architecture note on when to use dedicated vs hosted variants for RAG workloads and recommended batching/cache settings.

Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and metadata - [x] Add TypeScript agent quickstart with tool-calling example - [x] Add Python RAG demo with minimal indexer - [x] Docs quickstarts and snippets added to site navigation - [x] CI/docs build fixed on first failure and re-run - [x] Reviewed and approved by eng reviewers

Commits summary: - feat(rag): add faq/conversational/extractive RAG templates - feat(examples): add ts-agent-tooling quickstart and README - feat(examples): add py-rag-demo with simple FAISS index and test data - docs: add quickstarts pages and link from getting-started - fix(ci): pin mkdocs plugin version to resolve site build warning

Files changed (high level): - docs/quickstarts/rag.md - docs/quickstarts/agents.md - docs/nav.yml - redwood-examples/agents/ts-agent-tooling/README.md - redwood-examples/agents/ts-agent-tooling/src/index.ts - redwood-examples/agents/py-rag-demo/README.md - redwood-examples/agents/py-rag-demo/rag_demo.py - templates/rag/README.md - templates/rag/faq.template - templates/rag/conversational.template - templates/rag/extractive.template - mkdocs/plugins.yml (pin)
